description: Promotes institutional delivery to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality
eligibility: Eligible pregnant women meeting JSY criteria; eligibility and assistance vary by state category
benefits: Conditional cash assistance for eligible institutional deliveries
application_process: Contact the nearest government health facility or ASHA worker

description: Provides free healthcare entitlements to pregnant women and sick infants accessing public health institutions
eligibility: Pregnant women delivering in public health institutions and sick newborns and infants accessing public health facilities
benefits: Free delivery including C-section; medicines; diagnostics; blood; diet; transport; exemption from user charges
application_process: Visit the nearest government health facility or contact an ASHA worker
implementation_status: Implementation initiated in all States and UTs

description: Provides assured free antenatal care to pregnant women in their second and third trimesters on the 9th of every month
eligibility: Pregnant women in their second or third trimester
benefits: Free antenatal checkups; investigations; medicines; screening and identification of high-risk pregnancies
application_process: Visit a designated government health facility on the 9th of the month
source_name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
implementation_status: National programme; services through designated facilities

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: Provides cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization coverage to eligible beneficiaries
eligibility: Eligible families under scheme criteria; expanded coverage also includes senior citizens aged 70 years and above
benefits: Health cover up to Rs.5 lakh per eligible family per year at empanelled hospitals
application_process: Check eligibility through the official beneficiary portal or an empanelled hospital
implementation_status: Operational across all 36 States and UTs

description: Strengthens primary healthcare by providing comprehensive services closer to communities
eligibility: People in the catchment areas of operational Ayushman Arogya Mandirs
benefits: Primary healthcare; maternal and child care; screening for diabetes and hypertension; essential medicines and diagnostics
application_process: Visit the nearest operational Ayushman Arogya Mandir or contact the local ASHA worker
source_name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
implementation_status: Implemented through State and UT health systems

description: Supports States and Union Territories in strengthening public healthcare systems
eligibility: People accessing public health facilities across rural and urban areas
benefits: Support for maternal and child health; immunization; disease prevention and control; ASHA services; health infrastructure
application_process: Access services through government health facilities and State health departments
source_name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
implementation_status: Implemented through State and UT health systems

description: Andhra Pradesh health scheme providing cashless treatment for identified procedures through a network of empanelled hospitals
eligibility: Eligible beneficiaries meeting Andhra Pradesh government scheme criteria
benefits: Eligible treatment packages and cashless hospital services under scheme rules
application_process: Check eligibility and treatment availability through the official Trust or an empanelled hospital
source_name: Andhra Pradesh Health Medical and Family Welfare Department

description: Provides healthcare services to eligible Andhra Pradesh State Government employees pensioners and their dependents
eligibility: Eligible State Government employees pensioners and dependents subject to scheme rules
benefits: Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals for covered procedures
application_process: Check eligibility through the official Andhra Pradesh Employee Health Scheme portal

description: Provides maternity benefit financial assistance to eligible pregnant and lactating women
eligibility: Eligible pregnant and lactating women subject to scheme conditions and exclusions
benefits: Rs.5000 for eligible first child and Rs.6000 for eligible second child if the second child is a girl
application_process: Apply through the official PMMVY portal or designated Anganwadi or health facility
source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development
applicable_states: All States and UTs except Telangana
implementation_status: Implemented in 35 States/UTs; Telangana not implementing

description: Provides health screening and early intervention services for children from birth to 18 years
benefits: Screening for the 4 Ds: defects at birth; diseases; deficiencies; developmental delays including disabilities
application_process: Contact the nearest government health facility or RBSK mobile health team
implementation_status: National programme; implementation through State health systems

description: Addresses health and development needs of adolescents
benefits: Adolescent health education counselling and health services
application_process: Contact an adolescent friendly health clinic or government health facility
applicable_states: All States and UTs through State implementation
implementation_status: National programme; verify local service availability

description: Provides vaccination services to eligible children and pregnant women through the public health system
eligibility: Eligible infants children and pregnant women under the national immunization schedule
benefits: Routine vaccines and immunization services as per the national schedule
application_process: Visit the nearest government health facility or contact an ASHA or ANM worker
source_name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
implementation_status: National programme; services through public health facilities

description: Reported Andhra Pradesh health insurance programme; current scheme status and availability require official confirmation
eligibility: Eligibility to be confirmed from current Andhra Pradesh government notifications
benefits: Benefits and treatment coverage to be confirmed from current official scheme rules
application_process: Verify current availability with the Andhra Pradesh Health Department before applying
source_name: Andhra Pradesh Health Medical and Family Welfare Department
implementation_status: Historical implementation documented; current operational status requires official confirmation
